extra.message: SQL injection: user-supplied 'name' from ReferenceDataController.contactSearch (/api/reference/contact-search?name=) is concatenated directly into a JdbcTemplate query string (ILIKE '%"+name+"%'), allowing an authenticated attacker to alter the query and exfiltrate contact data.

LDAP injection: the 'team' value comes from the crm_directory_team cookie via StaffDirectoryController and is concatenated into the LDAP search filter '(&(objectClass=person)(department=...))' without escaping, allowing filter manipulation and directory enumeration.

OGNL expression injection: the user-controlled {rule} path variable is evaluated with Ognl.getValue(), which permits arbitrary method/static access and leads to remote code execution (the ognl library is on the classpath).

SpEL injection: the expression supplied in the /api/webhooks/route request body is parsed and evaluated against a StandardEvaluationContext with no restriction, allowing arbitrary bean/method invocation and remote code execution.

OS command injection: the 'format' request parameter from FileDownloadController.rendition is concatenated into a shell command executed via ProcessBuilder("sh","-c",...), allowing an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands.

OS command injection: request.reportUrl() from the /api/reports/render body is concatenated into a command string passed to ProcessBuilder("cmd","/c",...), so shell metacharacters in the URL allow arbitrary command execution.

Path traversal: the X-Rendition-Ref header (reference) is resolved directly under the renditions directory with no normalize()/startsWith containment check before Files.readString, allowing an authenticated user to read arbitrary files (e.g. ../../etc/passwd).

Path traversal: archiveSourceFeed resolves the client-supplied upload file name against archiveDir without verifying the result stays inside it, so a name containing ../ writes the uploaded feed outside the intended archive directory.

Path traversal: archiveCustomerHealthReport writes a file using the attacker-controlled 'name' request parameter of /api/reports/archive as a path relative to reportDropDir, with no containment check, allowing arbitrary file write outside the drop directory.

Server-Side Request Forgery: importFromLink fetches any caller-supplied URL with RestTemplate after only checking the http/https prefix, allowing requests to internal/cloud-metadata endpoints and returning the response body.

Insecure deserialization: an uploaded renewal policy is parsed with SnakeYAML's default new Yaml().load(), which permits instantiation of arbitrary Java types and can lead to remote code execution via YAML gadget chains (snakeyaml 1.30).

Improper JWT signature verification: JWTParser.parse() only decodes the assertion; the signature is never verified and issuer/audience are not checked. Since /partner/** is permitAll with CSRF disabled, an attacker can forge an assertion whose subject is any operator (e.g. a platform admin) and drive privileged deal transitions.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: Improper JWT signature verification: SignedJWT.parse() decodes the assertion but assertion.verify() is never called. The /partner/identity endpoint (permitAll, CSRF disabled) then trusts the unverified subject as the acting operator, letting an attacker impersonate a platform_admin and change any user's role, including self-promotion.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: Broken access control/IDOR: setContext stores any caller-supplied organizationId in the session without verifying the user can access it, and GET /api/portal/context/summary then returns that organization's name, plan and health score for any id, disclosing other tenants' data.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: Broken access control: queueFor(user, scopeRef) returns all escalations for the caller-supplied organization id without calling orgAccessService.assertAccess, unlike every other org-scoped lookup. A support agent can read any organization's escalations via the ?scope= parameter on the escalation queue.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting: the X-Partner-Site request header is written verbatim into a text/html response, so an attacker-controlled header value (e.g. <script>...) is executed by the browser/embedding partner page.

CORS misconfiguration: /api/** allows any origin pattern with allowCredentials(true). This reflects arbitrary origins, letting any malicious site make credentialed requests and read authenticated API responses (contacts, reports, etc.) on behalf of a logged-in user.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Credentials

extra.message: Clickjacking: X-Frame-Options is globally disabled (frameOptions().disable()), so any site can embed the authenticated CRM UI in an iframe and trick users into clicking privileged actions.

cwe: CWE-1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames

extra.message: Open redirect: on a security exception the controller redirects to the raw Referer header value without validation, allowing an attacker to craft a link that lands the victim on an arbitrary external site.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site

extra.message: Weak password recovery: resetPassword never marks the token used or deletes it, so despite the 'single-use' contract a reset code remains valid for its whole TTL and can be replayed to repeatedly overwrite the account password (the DB has an unused 'used' column).

cwe: CWE-640: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password

extra.message: Weak randomness: the customer-portal access code (used directly as the account's initial password) is generated with Math.random() instead of a cryptographically secure RNG, making it predictable/brute-forceable.

cwe: CWE-338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator

extra.message: Hardcoded credential: the billing partner gateway key 'btg_live_7c1f0a93e2' is committed as the default value for app.billing.gateway-key, exposing a production-looking secret in source control.
Sensitive information disclosure: server.error.include-stacktrace is set to 'always', returning full stack traces (internal paths, framework versions, SQL) to clients on errors.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: Security misconfiguration: all Actuator endpoints are exposed (management.endpoints.web.exposure.include: "*") and the management server binds to 0.0.0.0:9095, potentially exposing env, heapdump and other sensitive management data without authentication.

Hardcoded credential: DEMO_PASSWORD = "Passw0rd!2024" is used to create all seeded accounts (including the platform admin) and is seeded automatically when app.seed.enabled is true, which is the default.

JSON injection: filingRef and amount are concatenated into a JSON string sent to the partner tax gateway without escaping, letting an unauthenticated caller (endpoint is /partner/** permitAll) inject arbitrary JSON fields into the upstream filing request.

cwe: CWE-74: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component

extra.message: Server-Side Request Forgery: testDelivery posts to the stored, staff-supplied webhook targetUrl with no scheme/host allowlisting or restriction on internal addresses, enabling requests to internal services and metadata endpoints.
